title: {v} Shakshuka
steps: Soften the {v} with the {spice} in a wide pan with a little oil.
Pour in the {sauce} and simmer 10 minutes, until thick.
Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5 to 8 minutes, until the whites are fully set (160°F / 71°C for firm yolks).
Serve straight from the pan with the {s} for scooping.
tip: Pile in extra veg and scoop with bread instead of adding cheese.
